AGRICULTURE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Controlling Soil Erosion? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Controlling Soil Erosion.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Controlling Soil Erosion.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Controlling Soil Erosion.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Controlling Soil Erosion.

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem? (1 mark)

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem.

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc? (1 mark)

   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

22. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
